name: [UPDATE] Caramel 🌸 Cozy Pixel Farm
desc:
Caramel is the first pixel art cozy game on Roblox. Settle into the peaceful town of Craven's Hollow, make a home of your own, and spend each day doing what you enjoy. Play alone or with friends in a welcoming world made for all ages.

🌱 Grow crops and shape your farm.

🎣 Go fishing, gather items, and explore the town.

⛏️ Head into the mines to dig up ores, gems, and hidden treasures.

🏡 Decorate your home and customize your character.

🤝 Meet the locals and enjoy life together with friends.

🌦️ Experience changing days, nights, and weather.

✨ Take your time. There is no single way to play.
